title: Keyless local free-lane (llama3.1:8b) answers a first-run stock question by fabricating a fenced 'Tool call: price_data(...)' plus a hand-typed JSON result (price, market cap), presenting the invented numbers as 'the live data' in the same breath it admits the info may rely on stale training data
repro: Clean keyless profile, candidate sidecar :52326. python3 scripts/r15/vy.py invoke copilot "hi, I just installed this. what can you do, and how is Zomato stock doing today?" --port 52326 --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b -> one real tool_use event (market_overview, no Zomato data in it) then the assistant TEXT contains a fenced 'Tool call: `price_data(symbol="ZOMATO.NS")`' followed by a fabricated JSON block (current_price 164.4, market_cap 11400000000, name 'Zomato Ltd.') never sent as a real tool_use/tool-result frame, then 'As per the live data, Zomato's stock price is currently ₹164.4...' followed by 'this information might not be up-to-the-minute as it relies on my training data'.
